segments.name: Engineering Products and Services

segments.name: SunScout Products

segments.name: Solar Power Development Solutions
segments.description: Develops and installs solar power systems for commercial, industrial and institutional customers, including EPC services.
segments.evidence: This line of services represents our solar energy business segment that develops and installs solar power systems for commercial, industrial, and institutional customers, and provides engineering, procurement, and construction ("EPC") services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for turnkey EPC solar projects under contracts structured as fixed-price or cost-plus with milestone-based payments.
revenueModel.evidence: Projects are typically structured under fixed-price or cost-plus contracts, with milestone-based payment schedules.
